Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Sent: Monday, January 27, 2020 3:32 PM
To: Barb Goode <barbieg6884@yahoo.com>
Subject: Re: HI 
 
Hello my tall, dark and pretty friend Barb,

Thank you for coming to say hi! I've already told two people your riddle, I really liked it. When I talk to Dan next, I will see if he can solve it -- and give you credit. Shoot me an e-mail before you come to Lakeland. If I am there, we will definitely meet up.

Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Barb Goode <barbieg6884@yahoo.com>
Sent: Sunday, January 26, 2020 10:11 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: HI 
 
Hi Anthony,

It was nice seeing you and meeting your dad last night.  The event was very nice, however, I would have liked if they had Q&A with Al Avila!
Also, I didn't get a chance to ask DD about the 401K riddle!

I will be in Lakeland the week of March 9 and attending games on March 10 (Pirates)  and March 12 (Braves) both games at home.
I did not renew my partial season tics this coming season.  I will attend games when there are Bobblehead giveaways.  I like to display them
on my "Mickey" Mantle!
The news about Kobe are devastating.  He seemed like a real classy man in addition to his athletic abilities.
Your tall, dark and pretty friend,

P.S.   you'll notice my email has 6884 (the years the Tigers won the WS in my lifetime)
Hopefully, one year I will add to it!

From: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Sent: Wednesday, January 22, 2020 10:39 AM
To: Sung, Elaine <ESung@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: Hi
Nice meeting you, too! I’d say just leave that notebook lying around somewhere and one of these days in the next month I’ll pop in and get it. I’m at 734-752-9667 if you need anything.

Anthony Fenech
Detroit Free Press
Tigers beat writer
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Sung, Elaine <ESung@freepress.com>
Sent: Tuesday, January 21, 2020 9:58:06 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Hi 
 
Hey – it was nice to finally meet you! I look forward to your Pistons coverage …
You left your tiny little notebook here. What would you like me to do with it?
